# Navigation sidebar

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:recipe-navigation-sidebar` · Kerf UI · production recipe · Recipes

## When to use

Navigation sections with icon and iconless rows, a content-item surface, disclosure, and pane footer actions.

- A workspace sidebar needs the shared toolbar/content/footer pane model, 24px major section rhythm, and 44px row and utility-action targets.

**Not when:**

- Use ordinary links when menu selection, section, and sidebar anatomy do not apply.

## Imports

- Nothing to import: this is a reference composition.
- Declared side effects: lazy-recipe-css.

## Props

No props: this entry has no JavaScript API.
